start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj perimeter padhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kaunsa shape pasand hai?

turns.reply: Board par dekho: Kabir, triangle ko aise sochiye: teen seedhi sides milkar teen corners banati hain. Aap bataiye, iski kitni sides hain?

turns.line: board par rocket engine ka diagram banao
turns.reply: Rocket engine neeche se chauda metal chamber, andar flame, aur neeche narrow nozzle hota hai; perimeter ke liye teen boundary sides giniye.
Board par dekho: Ab triangle ka perimeter teenon sides ko jodkar milega. Agar sides 4 cm, 5 cm, 6 cm hon, aap total kitna nikaalenge?
